name: gmail_trash
description: Asks the user to move one conversation of their Gmail to the trash. It moves nothing: it leaves a request that the user confirms or dismisses with a button in the chat, and only their click moves it (Gmail keeps the trash 30 days). Use it only when the user asks to delete a message, by its number from the last gmail_inbox; to just clear the inbox, gmail_archive is enough. Returns one line saying the request is waiting for the user.

number.description: Conversation number from the last gmail_inbox (e.g. 3).
